nodes.text: Create a sunlit Copenhagen-style canal district with roughly thirty attached four- to six-story townhouses lining narrow cobbled streets and rectangular waterways. Use slender weathered facades in muted red, yellow, blue, gray, beige, and brick, with white-framed windows, arched doors, steep tiled roofs, dormers, and chimneys. Run a main waterfront street along a stone quay and connect smaller streets across canals with short arched bridges, including one opening onto a broad promenade with rounded landings. Edge the reflective water with stepped stone, timber retaining walls, and iron railings. Add regular trees, ornate lamps, bollards, benches, signs, crossings, puddles, and sparse weeds.

graph.prompt:
Create a sunlit Copenhagen-style canal district with roughly thirty attached four- to six-story townhouses lining narrow cobbled streets and rectangular waterways. Use slender weathered facades in muted red, yellow, blue, gray, beige, and brick, with white-framed windows, arched doors, steep tiled roofs, dormers, and chimneys. Run a main waterfront street along a stone quay and connect smaller streets across canals with short arched bridges, including one opening onto a broad promenade with rounded landings. Edge the reflective water with stepped stone, timber retaining walls, and iron railings. Add regular trees, ornate lamps, bollards, benches, signs, crossings, puddles, and sparse weeds.

    === GROUND ===
    Build the FLOOR FIRST, before placing anything else. Call the benchmark
    tool `ground_pass` as your first build action: it carpets the whole 200 m
    plate deterministically from a tile chosen for this scene. If you skip it,
    and do not tile a floor yourself, the scene renders as objects floating
    over empty space -- which is a failed reconstruction no matter how good
    the massing is. These palette entries are also flat surfaces you can tile
    by hand if you prefer:

      - SM_RoadRound | 8.0x8.0x0.00 m | /Game/NordicHarbour/Props/StreetModules/SM_RoadRound.SM_RoadRound
      - SM_Road | 8.0x8.0x0.00 m | /Game/NordicHarbour/Props/StreetModules/SM_Road.SM_Road
      - SM_DockFloor | 3.0x3.0x0.05 m | /Game/NordicHarbour/Props/StreetModules/SM_DockFloor.SM_DockFloor

=== ASSET PALETTE ===
Build this scene using ONLY the assets below — asset search is not available
in this run, so this list is your entire library. Format:

  id | name | category | width x depth x height (m) | spawn path

The id is what a scene graph refers to; the spawn path is what reaches UE.
You decide which to use, how many of each, and where they go — reuse entries
freely.
